title: Solitaire ring
description: An 18 ct yellow-gold solitaire in ISO 8653 ring sizes 44 to 72: a comfort-fit court shank and a four-prong basket head holding a round brilliant of 0.25 to 2 ct, cut to Tolkowsky's proportions and sized from its weight.
process: Lost-wax casting in 18 ct yellow gold, prongs seated and the stone set by hand, polished

difficulty.rationale: Datum planes through formula points, pattern and mirror of the facet cutters, sequenced booleans, a swept U-wire, fillets on persistent names (one conditional), a closed-form volume solved by a cube root, and expert gemology and setting knowledge.

standards: ISO 8653:2016 (ring size: inner circumference in mm)
Tolkowsky, Diamond Design (1919): table 53 %, crown angle 34.5°, pavilion angle 40.75°
GIA girdle thickness at the bezel positions
materials: 18 ct yellow gold (750, equal silver and copper), 15.4 g/cm³

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: stone 57 facets, 6.437 × 4.006 mm, 56.90 mm³, 0.2 g; shank 83.53 mm³ below the axis; prongs 1.095 mm, gallery 0.8 mm; culet 0.684 mm over the shank; gold 3.056 g, all as this example's; nine checks pass over the carat range; its seat cut was refused at 1.25 ct until tolerance 1e-7 mm (F-109); about 160 steps.
